parsed.note_claim: Tristan Buckmaster alleges OpenAI's proof builds on his and Levent Alpöge's recent work after learning of it, and OpenAI denies this.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Buckmaster, who says that OpenAI rushed ahead to solve the problem after learning of the work of Buckmaster and a colleague—Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge. ... Bubeck and other OpenAI executives denied that the company had ever inspected the pair's Codex prompts in order to inform their work.
parsed.reason: The Wired article directly reports Buckmaster's allegation that OpenAI rushed to solve the problem after learning of his and Alpöge's work, and reports OpenAI's denial.
